bio: Enjoy a deluxe Afternoon Tea in the Grade II listed Court House Hotel, in the Jailhouse Bar- Shoreditch. Infamously this was once housed private cells where prisoners were held while awaiting trial, now turned chic and luxurious bar.  Afternoon Tea can be enjoyed in the Jailhouse Bar, the perfect spot if you want to get away from the buzzing nightlife of Shoreditch and unwind. The Jailhouse offers a relaxing yet contemporary lounge bar, with chic quilted chairs and unique artwork hung from the walls.  Their Afternoon Tea menu offers a pot of your choice of loose leaf tea served with a selection of sandwiches, pastries and scones with raspberry jam and clotted cream, accompanied with the chef's choice of desserts.  This Baroque styled building can be found in the heart of Shoreditch, famous for its non-stop nightlife and eccentric style. For those visiting London it is the perfect location as it close to Old Street station, or if you enjoy to shop it is by Old Spitalfields Market.
